LMP: Our core fertilizer and weed control program: 6 visits, spaced 5 to 7 weeks apart from March through November, covering 7 services in total. Each visit is tailored to the season, and round 3 adds grub control as a double application.
HGP: Hydraguard helps the soil attract and hold moisture at the roots, improving turf health and seed germination, and can reduce watering needs by up to 50% for about 3 months.
PPP: Pest Control with 6 applications per year. Each visit we create a barrier around your home by spraying up 4 feet on exterior walls, out 2 feet along the foundation, and treating entry points, and we treat wasp nests we can safely reach. Exterior only.
COF: Aeration relieves soil compaction, then we spread seed right into the holes using an 80% Kentucky Bluegrass and 20% Rye blend. We will send written watering instructions so the seed takes.
CAO: Aeration relieves soil compaction, then we spread seed right into the holes using an 80% Kentucky Bluegrass and 20% Rye blend. We will send written watering instructions so the seed takes.
CAS: Aeration helps your lawn develop deeper, stronger roots, absorb water and nutrients more efficiently, and reduces thatch buildup. We aerate in spring and fall.
CAF: Aeration helps your lawn develop deeper, stronger roots, absorb water and nutrients more efficiently, and reduces thatch buildup. We aerate in spring and fall.
OLC: Treats the non-grass areas of your property, including driveways, sidewalks, curbs, gravel and rock beds, fence lines, and landscaping beds, to keep weeds from taking over. Runs 6 rounds per year.
OLW: Treats the non-grass areas of your property, including driveways, sidewalks, curbs, gravel and rock beds, fence lines, and landscaping beds, to keep weeds from taking over. Runs 6 rounds per year.
OW1: Treats the non-grass areas of your property, including driveways, sidewalks, curbs, gravel and rock beds, fence lines, and landscaping beds, to keep weeds from taking over. Runs 6 rounds per year.
BWC: A pre-emergent plus selective herbicide applied to flower beds on the first round, with a selective herbicide on rounds 2 through 6 to keep beds weed free.
TSP: Fertilizing treatments for strong root development and color, insect and disease control for common Utah pests, and dormant oil applications that target overwintering insects and eggs.
MCP: Also known as Yard Armour. Targets shaded foliage, under-deck areas, and other common mosquito rest spots with a blanket lawn and bush spray.
SEP: Applied on rounds 3 and 4 of the Lawn Maintainer Program. Improves turf health by boosting microbial activity and nutrient uptake.
WC: Herbicide treatment focused specifically on weeds, without the full fertilizer program.
WCO: Treats the weeds already growing in your lawn with a selective herbicide that leaves your turf unaffected. This is a one-time application.
GCN: Treats an active grub infestation already damaging your lawn's roots with a targeted insecticide. The price covers this one application; a follow-up is available at additional cost if grubs are still active.
GCC: This visit treats grubs that are still active despite your earlier preventive Grub Control application, at no additional charge.
GCP: Grub Control is a targeted insecticide applied to protect or treat your lawn's roots from root-feeding grubs.
PSS: Used mainly for bare dirt areas or new-build lawns. The machine roughs up the soil and drops seed directly in, and it takes about a full year to become a full, thick lawn.
PSF: Used mainly for bare dirt areas or new-build lawns. The machine roughs up the soil and drops seed directly in, and it takes about a full year to become a full, thick lawn.
OVS: Introduces new grass seed to thicken your lawn and fill in bare or thin spots, using an 80% Kentucky Bluegrass and 20% Rye blend broadcast onto your existing lawn. Watering is critical, and we will send written instructions.
FO: Granular, timed-release fertilizer application without weed control.
SSF: We overseed specific bare or thin spots in your lawn with our Kentucky Bluegrass and Rye blend to help them fill back in.
SBO: Clears every line in your irrigation system before winter to protect it from freeze damage. We calibrate air pressure to your pipe material and zone layout, and it is done once each fall.
